name: What kind of cost considerations should I prepare for with a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of cost considerations should I prepare for with a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a whole-home renovation, clients should prepare for a significant investment that reflects the scope of work, quality of materials, and customization involved. We specialize in high-value renovations that emphasize craftsmanship and customized solutions, rather than basic or low-cost options. Costs will encompass design, demolition, structural work, high-end finishes for kitchens and luxury bathrooms, new flooring, lighting, custom built-ins, and permit coordination. AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates and explores value engineering options where appropriate to ensure your investment aligns with your vision and enhances your home's long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a significant investment in a whole-home renovation, covering design, structural work, high-end finishes, and customization, with AKN Design Group providing upfront estimates and value engineering options.
